title: Pipet positioning accuracy test (FITC-filled pipet imaging)
goal: Measure repeatability of PHIL pipet positioning by imaging a FITC-filled pipet returning to the centre of well F12 after traveling across a 96-well plate.

title: Pump calibration, volume accuracy, flow-rate accuracy and automated FITC dilution series
goal: Quantify the accuracy of PHIL peristaltic pumps gravimetrically and by automated versus manual FITC dilution curves.

title: Dynamic FITC/PBS media exchange pulses and oscillations in 96-well plates
goal: Test PHIL's ability to rapidly and durably change media composition (single pulse, 15 s oscillations, 2 h oscillations over 48 h, parallel wells) by imaging FITC fluorescence.

title: Pipet carry-over and wash-step cross-contamination test
goal: Quantify FITC carry-over between wells by reusable pipets and the reduction achieved by 1, 4 and 8 automated wash steps.

title: Automated immunostaining of murine bone and cerebrum tissue sections
goal: Show that PHIL can perform multi-step immunostaining of thick tissue sections while preserving morphology.
unresolved_refs: Samples fixed, decalcified, sectioned as previously described (ref 57)

title: Automated immunostaining of GATA2VENUS myeloid progenitors
goal: Validate automated anti-VENUS immunostaining of sorted non-adherent progenitors against FACS values and test for cross-contamination with a secondary-only control.
unresolved_refs: Cells isolated and sorted 'as previously described' (refs 31,53)

title: Gentle automated washing of human CD34+ HSPCs in ibidi μ-Slide VI0.4
goal: Compare cell loss after manual versus automated PBS washing at different flow speeds in fixed flow-sensitive HSPCs.

title: ESC proliferation and survival in PHIL versus standard live-cell incubator
goal: Test whether culture inside PHIL affects mouse ESC time to first division and cell numbers over 36 h.

title: GMP displacement test during automated media exchange
goal: Determine whether PHIL media washes displace non-adherent murine GMPs during time-lapse imaging.
unresolved_refs: Cells isolated and sorted 'as previously described' (refs 31,53)

title: Dynamic TNFα stimulation of GFP-p65/H2B-mCHERRY GMPs with time-lapse imaging
goal: Apply different TNFα stimulation patterns via PHIL during confocal time-lapse imaging and quantify single-cell p65 nuclear translocation dynamics.
